title: Commercial Platforms
summary: Fall Creek's own description of its three commercialisation routes: the closed SEKOYA member platform founded in 2017, the Fall Creek Collection for wider licensing, and an open catalogue. States a SEKOYA membership figure of 14.
why_it_matters: This is the clearest company-authored statement of how Fall Creek segments its genetics between closed-club and open licensing, which is the core of its competitive model. The membership count conflicts with a trade-press figure of 15, so the number is treated as disputed.

reading.rationale: Defines the commercial architecture that every Fall Creek variety record sits inside.

commercial_position.rationale: Closed versus open licensing is the primary axis of competitive differentiation among blueberry breeders.

monitoring.rationale: Membership counts and platform composition change between seasons and should be re-read annually.
